source.citation: Mohan, Undeland, Robbins (2003). Power Electronics, 3rd ed., Ch.5. Bridge rectifier with cap smoothing; finite diode drop and capacitor discharge dominate the KPIs.

sim_completed.description: 1 if LTspice transient sweep ran without errors, else 0

selected_cap_uF.description: Smallest capacitor from {220, 330, 470, 680} uF that keeps ripple below 1.5 Vpp
selected_cap_uF.T_good_source: LTspice stepped Cval list shows 330 uF has 1.811 Vpp ripple and 470 uF has 1.339 Vpp, so 470 uF is the smallest passing value.

vout_avg.description: Time-average of V(p) over the steady-state window for selected_cap_uF
vout_avg.T_good_source: Oracle stepped LTspice 26.0.1 transient at selected C=470 uF; 250-300 ms averaging window.

vrip_pp.description: Peak-to-peak excursion of V(p) over the same steady-state window for selected_cap_uF
vrip_pp.T_good_source: Oracle stepped LTspice 26.0.1 transient at selected C=470 uF. Naive ripple formulas miss because diode drop and finite discharge shape matter.
